about: The Sign of the Cross joins the gesture of the cross to a brief invocation of the Holy Trinity.

seg.tr: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

fn.w003: Genitive depending on “nómine” (w002), parallel to “Fílii” (w005) and “Spíritus” (w007).
fn.w007: “Spíritus” can be nominative or genitive. Agreement with “Sancti” (w008) establishes the genitive here.
